'''Operation Sweeping Menace''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and the Imperial Navy [[Battle of the Polith system|broke]] a blockade in the [[Polith system]] and [[Battle of Sululluub|wiped out]] the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Ash Angels]] at [[Sululluub]].
